reasoning: The two attempts are functionally equivalent and both correct. Each uses four groups ordered content, state, look, then story-only. Each wraps every group and control in Ordered, updates every read and the StoryProps type, keeps every default and range, and passes all tools. A is ahead by a small margin. Its Content order puts each value next to the toggle that controls it (NameOverride then ShowName, Count then ShowCount), which makes the panel easier to scan. Its `Ordered` alias and the comment explaining why ordering is needed also make the code read slightly better. B's group names (Look, Preview) are a bit better than A's (Appearance, Story), but that does not outweigh A's more logical layout inside Content.

luau-lsp, selene and StyLua all pass.
